R7AC-bear-backcountry-0001.name: 180 m N of Canoe River
R7AC-bear-backcountry-0001.pressureWhy: More than 5 km from a drivable road (estimate).
R7AC-bear-backcountry-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed paved road

evidence.t: Burn from 2018 (fire G31313), 100 m NE: burned areas are spring bear food (90%) and huckleberry grows in old burns (80%) (lessons: Black bear Masterclass 5, Habitat tour).
S facing slope, 30 degrees: grassy south facing slopes are spring bear food (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
Canoe River 180 m S: stream sides and skunk cabbage swamps are spring food, and bears forage on berries and spawning fish in fall (90%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 5).
1 km or more from pavement and 2 km from a town: bears near people feed more at night (75%, lesson: Black bear Masterclass 6).

plan: Drive: from Village of Valemount, about 20 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 52.72811, -119.41065, pull off on an unnamed paved road. Map links below.
Walk: 8.8 km W, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 422 m, about 217 min at 3 km/h.
Camp: flat ground 280 m SW of the spot at 992 m (52.7319, -119.54341). Water: Canoe River 50 m N (estimate).

Hunt: black bear, Apr, May, June, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Glass berry slopes, cutblocks and road edges at dawn and the last 2 hours of light, wind in your face (Tip). A bear under 2 years old and any bear with it are closed (99%, synopsis page 11).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 180 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-2, Region 7A. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-05, closures 2026-10-16.
R7AC-bear-backcountry-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-2: about 179 hunter days a year for black bear (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.05 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: more than 5 km from a drivable road. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
